references.text: Dibon is mentioned as a city conquered by the Israelites, the same place from which the people set out in Num 33:46
Dibon is one of the cities that the tribe of Gad asked to receive as an inheritance, which explains the name 'Dibon-Gad'
The children of Gad built up Dibon, confirming the connection between Gad and this city
Dibon is mentioned as a city in the inheritance allotment of the tribe of Reuben, in the same geographical area
The prophecy against Moab mentions Dibon, showing the city's significance in the region
Jeremiah prophesies against Dibon in his judgment over Moab
Beth-Diblathaim (Almon-Diblathaim) is mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against Moab, the same place where the Israelites camped
Diblah is mentioned in Ezekiel as a geographical marker, possibly the same place as Diblathaim
